description:
Inspired by the minimalist phone concept, a decluttered experience brought to the quotidian smartphone, Stario aims to keep functionality and productivity at their peak in a simple and elegant format. Oh, and by the way, it is all free!
FEATURES
• Material You Support
• Application Customization
• Built-In Weather Widget
• Global Search Integration
• Minimalist Media Player Controls
• Application Categories
• RSS/Atom Reader
• Page Sorting
PRIVACY
Stario fully respects your privacy. It does not collect app usage or personal data, and it may very well protect your data better than yourself!
ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE
Stario’s Accessibility Service is used exclusively to let you turn off your phone’s screen with a gesture. It is optional, disabled by default and doesn’t collect or share any data.
